sara: Quick snapshot from the StableFlux-11B bringup (quant runs done). TL;DR: int4 gives big cost upside and lower p50 latency, but we see quality regressions on long-form and code slices. Looking for routing + GTN guidance.

kevin: Can you paste the unit-econ numbers?

sara: Sure — baseline is stableflux-11b-int8 (FP16-ish perf). Key numbers from the eval slices: 
- tokens/sec: int8=320, int4=760
- p50 latency: int8=140ms, int4=95ms
- p95 latency: int8=380ms, int4=420ms
- cost / 1M tokens: int8=$18, int4=$9
- helpfulness (avg on product-like eval): int8=0.84, int4=0.79
- longform F1-like fidelity drop: ~7 points for int4 on >2048 token prompts
- safety flag rate: int4 = 1.8x int8 on our safety-sensitive slices
- code fidelity (BLEU-ish on code slices): int8=0.72, int4=0.63

maria: That p95 regression for int4 on long contexts suggests KV cache quant noise / more decoder iterations. Did you check kv-cache hit behavior?

sara: Yep — we see more cache mismatches on int4 after the 1k token mark (probing shows larger attention rounding noise). Also observed slightly more tokenization boundary issues that affect code.

jason: For code prompts specifically, are errors truncation or semantic hallucinations?

sara: Mostly truncation + subtle API-name swaps. Semantic hallucinations on long multi-step examples are up too, but rarer.

maria: Recommendation?

sara: Proposing a hybrid routing policy by prompt length + intent. Rough plan:
- short queries (<64 tokens) -> int4 (saves the most; quality delta negligible)
- medium queries (64-1024) -> 60% int4 / 40% int8 (mix to balance cost/quality)
- long queries (>1024) -> int8 only (avoid regressions)
Estimated impact: ~38% cost reduction vs all-int8 on our traffic mix, expected product-level helpfulness delta <1% if we do canary + quick rollback.

sara: Example routing flag (will open PR):
```
routes:
  - name: short
    max_tokens: 64
    model: stableflux-11b-int4
  - name: medium
    max_tokens: 1024
    distribution:
      stableflux-11b-int4: 0.6
      stableflux-11b-int8: 0.4
  - name: long
    model: stableflux-11b-int8
fallback: stableflux-11b-int8
```

kevin: What's the rollout/canary and rollback plan?

sara: Start with 10% canary for 48h. Monitor the canary eval set (helpfulness, hallucination rate) + production alerts: latency SLOs, safety flags. Auto-rollback if helpfulness drops >2% absolute or hallucination rate >1.5x baseline. Also will run daily sampled human evals on 500 items for first week.

jason: Product question: can GTN (growth/partnership) ship with hybrid routing? They care about deterministic behavior for some flows.

maria: For safety-critical or partner routes we should pin to int8 and mark as "deterministic" in routing. Also provide a short prompt guidance doc: preferred prompt templates, seeds, and recommended max_tokens to avoid hitting long-context regressions.

maria: I'll author the prompt guidance doc and sample prompts for GTN.

jason: I'll run extra code-slice unit tests (1000 code prompts) against int4/int8 and share diff heatmap.

sara: Thanks — I'll open the canary PR with routing flags, add the canary eval set, and schedule the 10% rollout for Monday EOD.
